messages:
Maria S.: Quick sync on ORCA pilot readiness — need final owners for integration deliverables and any network/IP whitelisting before Wed cutover. Dry run is Tue 9am PST, final cutover Thu 2pm PST. Can owners confirm? @Sanjay @Neil :eyes:
Neil K.: I can own staging webhooks + cert install. Will have a short runbook by EOD Mon.
Sanjay R.: I'll own model config, rollout knobs, and the PR for autoscale. Question: what's expected peak qps for dry run?
Maria S.: Expected peak ~120 qps for the dry run (90th pct payload). Production target 300 qps. Success criteria: no errors >1% and 95th latency <250ms for RPCs.
Tess L.: For networking I'll need the customer's egress IPs (or CIDR) and whether they want VPC peering or public endpoints. Also confirm ports 443 and 5432 (metrics DB) are allowed.
Neil K.: Pinged ORCA infra contact — Matt — asked for CIDR. He replied: "sending CIDR now, ETA 30m".
Sanjay R.: Also flag: PR #3421 (https://git.redwood/infra/pull/3421) updates the KV cache TTL to avoid cold starts for short sessions — needs 1 reviewer from eng-runtime. Can someone pick it up?
Maria S.: @Sanjay can you add a 1-line test plan in the PR description? Makes review faster. I'll @eng-runtime in the PR thread after that.
Neil K.: I'll take the review if it's small, otherwise tag Erin.
Tess L.: For monitoring: please add the synthetic query we discussed to the dry-run dashboard (query id: orca-synth-2026). I can wire alerting after the dry run.
Maria S.: Owners summary: webhooks/certs -> Neil; model/config/PR -> Sanjay; networking/peering -> Tess; success criteria + coordination -> Maria. I'll update the pilot tracker doc: https://docs.redwood/orca/pilot-runbook
Sanjay R.: One blocker: our dedicated pool has a quant profile mismatch with the model they want. I can spin a compatible variant but need approval to enable fallback. Approving now would allow smoother cutover.
Maria S.: Approved to enable fallback for the cutover window only. Please note in the runbook and add a rollback step.
Neil K.: Small ask — can solutions eng get a sample request payload + expected headers so we can validate proxy routing?
Maria S.: Sending sample payload and headers in a follow-up DM.
deploy-bot: Reminder: dry-run scheduled Tue 16:00 UTC (9am PST). Please have runbook and owners confirmed at least 12h prior.
Tess L.: All good from SRE side as long as the CIDR and DB access are confirmed.
Neil K.: CIDR received and whitelisting requested. ETA from security is Tue 03:00 UTC.
Maria S.: Perfect — last ask: add the ticket link to the tracker when you create the rollout checklist (so PM and SEs can verify). I'll do a short readout Tue 11am PST.
Sanjay R.: Will add PR link and rollout checklist by EOD.
Maria S.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
